run_ProcessProjectAria_main: run the ProcessProjectAria CLI to generate a nerfstudio dataset from a Project Aria VRS file and MPS attachments
create_aria_image_frame: create an AriaImageFrame from a VRS data provider by extracting image data and matching it to the nearest pose timestamp
get_camera_calibs: get the per-camera factory calibration intrinsics and distortion parameters from a Project Aria VRS data provider
read_trajectory_csv_to_dict: read a closed loop trajectory CSV file and return TimedPoses with nanosecond timestamps and SE3 world-to-device transforms
convert_to_nerfstudio_frame: convert an AriaImageFrame into a nerfstudio-compatible dictionary with camera intrinsics, distortion params, and transform matrix
